function.arguments: {"observation": "The contract defines the population as 'all patients who completed the trial, with one row per patient (deduplicated by highest sample_seq)'. However, the filter `biomarker_baseline != -999` removes 93 rows (11% of data), which are patients who may have completed the trial (they have `responded` and `biomarker_final` values). The contract does not specify excluding patients based on baseline assay quality. Therefore, excluding them violates the population definition.", "implication": "The analysis population is not the one specified in the contract. The contract requires 'all patients who completed the trial', but by filtering out those with `biomarker_baseline == -999`, we are excluding patients who may have completed the trial. Since it does not, we must include them."}
